title: Programme
description: A company or institution programme that helps MBA students or MBA aspirants build skills or get exposure (pre-MBA programmes, webinars, free learning, virtual job simulations, mentoring). Not a case competition: those live in data/competitions.json.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'host-title-year'. Never changes once created.

programme_type.description: pre_mba = early-access programme for admitted MBA students; insight_event = webinars/workshops; virtual_experience = self-paced job simulation; learning = courses/certifications; mentorship; leadership programme; internship.

audience.description: 'mba' = only MBA students/admits; 'open' = anyone, including MBA aspirants.

eligibility.description: Plain-words who can apply, as stated by the organiser. Say if India/Indian schools are not eligible.

cost.description: 'not_specified' when the organiser's page does not say. Never guess.

deadline.description: Application deadline, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when date_status is 'confirmed'; null for 'expected' and 'rolling'.

date_status.description: 'confirmed' = dates announced. 'expected' = recurring programme whose next dates are not announced (shown as Upcoming). 'rolling' = always open or self-paced (shown as Open).

expected_window.description: Required when date_status is 'expected'. Cite the past edition or the organiser's note in review_notes.

needs_review.description: true = hidden from the public site until a human approves

region.description: India = India-based. International = outside India (check eligibility). Global = online, no country limit stated.
